arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# March 31, 1950
max_1950 = 275000
subject_1950 = 255013
utilization_1950 = (subject_1950 / max_1950) * 100

# March 31, 1955
max_1955 = 281000
subject_1955 = 273571
utilization_1955 = (subject_1955 / max_1955) * 100

# Arithmetic mean
mean_utilization = (utilization_1950 + utilization_1955) / 2

print(f'1950 utilization: {utilization_1950}%')
print(f'1955 utilization: {utilization_1955}%')
print(f'Mean utilization: {mean_utilization}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimals: {round(mean_utilization, 2)}')
"
